Topics covered in this PDF

BCOS-184 (E-Commerce) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • E-commerce types, payment gateways, websites and HTTP versus HTTPS, cyber security and cybercrime, E-tailing and the 7C's of retail mix, emerging technologies
  • NEFT, RTGS and IMPS, website development strategies, cyber forensics, Certifying Authority, Appellate Tribunal, digital influencers, web servers, E-services, app stores

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.
